summary: The contract, sunflower conventions and degree-case architecture are mathematically coherent at the Round 1 framing level. The manuscript distinguishes its new size-68 exclusions from imported small-rank structure and from end-to-end formal verification. I found no necessary framing revision in the inspected material. This is a continue decision, not certification of every classification, family-to-model bridge or finite leaf.

findings.statement: H27, Jin and the specified prior classifications remain substantive imported mathematical inputs. The current manuscript states this boundary, including the absence of a local H27 ledger replay and use of Nikiforov's exact Jin restatement.
findings.disposition: The ordinary computer-assisted framing is appropriate. This round checks the import interface and stated limitations; it does not independently certify those external proofs.

findings.statement: The new contribution is framed as the size-68 contradiction plus its new low-degree and strengthened high-degree ingredients. The universal fifteen-triple statement has arbitrary-support quantifiers, while represented finite cores in the high-degree models are explicitly projections rather than ambient-support cutoffs.
findings.disposition: No quantifier conflict was found in the statements. Detailed arbitrary-support and finite-domain completeness remain obligations for subsequent substantive rounds.

checks.scope: Literal theorem, hereditary size restriction and complete-link conventions
checks.method: Read manuscript Sections 1, 3 and 4 and global-dag Section 1; checked the set-theoretic implications directly.
checks.observation: Distinct members, exact uniformity, finite arbitrary support and empty cores are explicit. A sunflower in a point link lifts by adjoining the root, so SF3 bounds can control complete point degrees. Excluding exactly 68 members implies the at-least-68 statement by hereditary restriction. The warning to retain every selected root cone when restricting a larger family correctly protects completeness of the link.

checks.scope: H27 transfer to neighbourhood and graph invariants
checks.method: Checked manuscript Section 3 against external-scope, Application to the current conventions, and reconstructed the implication.
checks.observation: For an actual R, two mutually disjoint members of its disjoint subfamily would form an empty-core sunflower with R. Hence H27 gives |N[R]| >= 68-27 = 41. Independent sets of the disjointness graph are intersecting SF4 subfamilies, giving independence number at most 27; a triangle is precisely three pairwise disjoint members and is forbidden.

checks.scope: Guarded structural imports and exhaustive maximum-degree partition
checks.method: Read manuscript Sections 3-6, prior-unlock, and global-dag Sections 1-2; compared the ordering of hypotheses and cases.
checks.observation: The universal cap gives Delta <= 20. The sequence excludes 20, 19, 18, 17, 16 and then all remaining degrees <=15. The Delta <=18 guarded cross-star, crowding, minimum-degree and R61 package is activated after the 20 and 19 exclusions. R16 is explicitly restricted to size 16 with rho <=7, and Q8 permits the specified leaf overlaps. No gap in the stated degree partition or premature use of the guarded package was found at this architectural level.

checks.scope: Direct Jin A3 hypothesis and nonempty-fibre interface
checks.method: Read direct-jin and manuscript Section 6; verified the strict integer comparison and all eight cyclic coefficient identities with a bounded standard-library calculation.
checks.observation: The strict gap is 25*11-4*68 = 3. For each i, b_i+b_(i+3)+b_(i+5) counts every fibre once and a_i twice. Since the three neighbours of any A3 index are independent, b_i <=27 holds even before surjectivity. The deficits sum to 12, forcing a_i >=1; only then is b_i >=25 inferred from an actual vertex. The resulting r_i sum is 4. This interface does not assume a complete blowup.

checks.observation: The strongest-located upper-68 comparison is explicitly bounded by the literature search, the lower 54 is not presented as new, and the general ground-set conjecture is distinguished from the fixed-rank claim. This check assesses the wording and division of contribution, not exhaustive priority.
